_meta.description: Per-row latent scores from a structural equation model on brand_survey.pulse via ATTR_SEM_SCORE: the three-factor CFA (quality =~ q1 + q2 + q3, value =~ v1 + v2 + v3, service =~ s1 + s2 + s3) fitted inline as MAT_SEM's joint multi-group fit across the two waves (params.group wave) with loadings and intercepts held equal (group_equal), so every row is scored with its own wave's parameters on one latent-mean scale (wave1, the reference, at 0). value_score and service_score are lavaan's regression scores (lavPredict's default), service_bartlett the Bartlett score of the same fit. Averaged by wave, the scores track the latent mean shift MAT_SEM reports for the same model: value down about 0.24 and service up about 0.52 in marker units, quality unchanged. The fit is cohort-wide, never per request group; grouping runs the request buffered.
